text:
GTA 6 is out, and Esquire has matched the in-game watches to real ones. The gold Crowex is a near dead ringer for the Rolex Day-Date. A silver chronograph resembles the Rolex Daytona, and a digital watch resembles the Casio Pro Trek range. Covgari owes more to Audemars Piguet, and Takio nods to the Casio F-91W. Esquire reportedly counts 34 collectible watches in the game.

Source: Esquire UK (19 Nov 2026); Day-Date match also watchesoff5th, citing GQ and WatchPro.
Images: Rockstar Games, via Esquire. Watch photos: Casio Pro Trek, Wikimedia Commons, Geographer, CC BY 2.5; Daytona 126500LN, Rolex.
